column1: # The payload runs from a signed SD bundle and is not OTA-updated
# ota_0/ota_1 app partitions. The loader's own table stays at 0x20000; this one
# lives in the free 0x10000 sector so the payload's esp_partition/NVS calls can
# find their state partitions. Keep every offset out of the loader's regions:
# Metadata-only app entry. IDF's esp_partition_main_flash_region_safe() calls
# esp_ota_get_running_partition() and asserts when no app partition exists
# NVS erase/write would otherwise abort. The payload actually executes from
# PSRAM; this entry describes the loader's flash app slot so the safety check
# has a non-NULL range. It is never booted or updated.
